## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `da5cf79ddc2cb344f2ec74cc86df9340405b3fb3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0038-build-verification-loop.md, docs/adr/0046-package-docs-as-metadata.md, docs/adr/0051-inline-metadata-views-in-docs.md, docs/adr/0052-audit-is-not-the-activity-feed.md, docs/adr/README.md + scripts/adr-index.mjs, .github/workflows/lint.yml, packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts, packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts, cloud `packages/service-ai-studio/src/verify/graph-lint.ts`, cloud `packages/service-ai-studio/src/plugin.ts`, cloud `packages/service-ai-studio/src/tools/verify-build.tool.ts`, cloud `packages/service-ai-studio/src/verify/plan-conformance.ts`, cloud `.github/workflows/eval-golden-prompts.yml`, cloud `.changeset/eval-golden-prompts-schedule-off.md`, cloud `packages/service-ai/src/eval/eval-runner.ts`, packages/spec/src/system/doc.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-schemas.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts, ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx, ui/apps/console/src/pages/AppDocsIndex.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/DocPreview.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/BookPreview.tsx, packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/metadata-viewer.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-markdown/src/MarkdownImpl.tsx, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment.object.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment-reaction.object.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-chatter.tsx, hotcrm `src/sales/actions/activity-actions.ts`

### ① Derived judgments

- **Diff shape.** The net diff against `main` (three-dot, byte-identical to the fetched `net.diff`) touches exactly the five `hits` files: four `**Status**:` lines and the regenerated index — 10 additions, 10 deletions, nothing else. No accept-set, no published schema, no runtime surface changes. **Right.**
- **Keyword column.** Each new line keeps the keyword as the first word after `**Status**: ` (`Accepted` ×4); `statusKeywordOf` reads the earliest `STATUS_KEYWORDS` entry within 80 chars and the lowercase `implemented` / `proposed` / `revised` later in each value do not match (case-sensitive `indexOf`), so no line drifts to `Implemented`, `Proposed` or `Revised`. Summary table Accepted 112 → 116, Proposed 18 → 14, Total 144 unchanged. **Right.**
- **Status cells.** `statusCell` = keyword + ` — ` + `cell(detail, 64)`; `detail` strips the keyword and leading dashes, and `cell` cuts at 63 chars + `…`. All four values share the 63-char prefix `2026-10-28 (ruled on objectstack#26553, ADR batch 2; proposed 2`, which is what the four README rows carry. **Right.**
- **Date column.** None of the four records has a `**Date**:` header field, so `date` falls back to the first ISO date in the status value — `2026-10-28` on all four rows (was the proposal date). Identical to the batch-1 rows already on `main` (`ADR-0022`/`0026`/`0027` → `2026-10-27`). **Right** by the generator's rule; the proposal date survives in the status prose.
- **Supersession cells.** `ADR-0038`'s `cloud ADR-0025` comes from the header blockquote arm (`> **🔶 Cloud-owned — superseded in part by cloud ADR-0025`), untouched. `ADR-0046`'s `· **Superseded in part (2026-06-13, ADR-0048)**` bullet is neither a `**Key**:` field nor a `>` line, so it yields no reference — `—`, unchanged from before. **Right.**
- **Index currency on the head.** `pnpm check:adr-index` is `--self-test && --report` and REPORT-ONLY (exit 0 on a stale index), so a green check proves nothing by itself. The `ADR index is current (report-only …)` step ran in `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (check-run 122595143324) on `da5cf79…` and its annotations carry no `::warning::` (only the runner-image notice) — so on the head tree the committed README equals the rendering and every record parsed. **Right.**
- **Index currency after merge.** `origin/main` has advanced four commits past the PR's merge-base `a90163d477` (to `cb8988ee`); `git diff a90163d477 origin/main -- docs/adr/ ui/docs/adr/ scripts/adr-index.mjs` is empty, so the regenerated README stays current when this lands. **Right.**
- **ADR-0050.** `git diff origin/main prr-27034 -- docs/adr/0050-form-layout-vs-presentation.md` is empty; its README row still reads `Proposed — 2026-06-15 · Amended (2026-10-20 …)`, as the ruling's item 3 requires. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the PR body; `skip-changeset` label present; `Check Changeset` skipped by the label; the diff publishes nothing (docs/adr only). No narrowing is declared and none exists in the diff. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- *"ADR-0050 … 本 PR 不动它"* — answered: untouched (①). The ruling's item 3 (set aside → #27032) is honoured.
- *"re-verified on `origin/main` `a90163d477` and cloud `ce05c91`"* — `main` moved to `cb8988ee` and the local cloud clone is at `ce2ed267` (2026-10-28); every claim below was re-read against those, not the PR body's shas. Nothing in the four moved `main` commits touches the cited code.
- *Governed Surface Queue Guard* shows two runs on the head: `cancelled` (02:27:49–02:28:05) superseded by `success` (02:28:08–02:28:26). The later run governs; not a red.
- *ADR-0052 §6 P0b* body still says `sys_notification` is **deferred** and flags the move as "a call for this record's owner". Answered by the tree: `plugin-audit` registers `[SysAuditLog, SysActivity, SysComment, SysCommentReaction]` only (`audit-plugin.ts`), `service-messaging` registers `SysNotification` (`messaging-service-plugin.ts:322,579`), `service-storage` registers `SysAttachment` (`storage-service-plugin.ts:436`). The status line is right; the body paragraph is stale (④, should-fix, out of this PR's status-line-only scope).
- `open_questions`: none declared on the PR or the card. Pending checks: none — all 40 check-runs are `completed`.

### ④ Design judgment

Each line judged against ruling 6458958232 (letter and parentheticals) and against `origin/main` (`cb8988ee`) / cloud `ce2ed267`.

**docs/adr/0038-build-verification-loop.md — Accepted (ruling item 1: A).** Letter matches.
- L1 graph lint: cloud `service-ai-studio/src/verify/graph-lint.ts` ("ADR-0038 L1 — graph lint: cross-artifact reference resolution"). **True.**
- L3 runtime probes: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts` (`RuntimeBuildIssue`, "ADR-0038 L3"); probe report `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:1578`; probes ride `publishPackageDrafts` (`objectql/src/build-probes.test.ts`). **True.**
- L4 `verify_build` self-correction: cloud `tools/verify-build.tool.ts` (`name: 'verify_build'`), `plugin.ts:1109` ("ADR-0038 L1/L4 … verifies-fixes-reverifies"), auto-publish posture gate; build-health line in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:1948`. The ADR's LLM "intent review" is not built — `verify/plan-conformance.ts` emits deterministic `layer: 'intent'` issues instead — but the line scopes L4 to `verify_build`, as the ruling does. **True as written.**
- L5 golden-prompt evals "implemented": the harness exists (`scripts/eval/golden-prompts.mjs`, `scripts/eval/cases.json`, `service-ai/src/eval/eval-runner.ts` on `ai_eval_cases`/`ai_eval_runs`), but the cited `.github/workflows/eval-golden-prompts.yml` opens with: *"THE NIGHTLY SCHEDULE IS DISABLED (2026-08-04, cloud#1119) … THIS SUITE NOW RUNS ONLY WHEN A HUMAN CLICKS 'Run workflow'. NOTHING WATCHES THE GOLDEN PROMPTS ON ITS OWN. This is ABANDONED COVERAGE, not a fix — the bug it was reporting (no eval environment) is still open"*; the three `EVAL_*` secrets "have never been provisioned"; `.changeset/eval-golden-prompts-meta-singular.md`: *"this suite doesn't actually run today"*. ADR-0038 defines L5 as the suite that *"runs headlessly against an ephemeral environment per cloud deploy (and nightly), recording to ai_eval_runs"*. On the tree L5 is built and unarmed; the line calls it implemented and names no pending half. The card's own rule for an A is that the line 写明待办. **must-fix** — keep `Accepted`, move the arming to pending, e.g. `L5 golden-prompt harness built (cloud eval-golden-prompts.yml, scripts/eval/golden-prompts.mjs on ai_eval_cases / ai_eval_runs) but unarmed — nightly schedule off since 2026-08-04 and no eval environment (cloud#1119); pending: L2 renderability contract (dataset compile only today), L5 arming`. The ruling's letter (A) is unchanged by this; only the implementation reading is corrected. **FAIL.**
- L2 pending: no renderability layer found in framework or cloud (`graph-lint.ts` emits no `layer: 'render'`); "dataset compile only" is the conservative reading. **True.**

**docs/adr/0046-package-docs-as-metadata.md — Accepted (ruling item 2: A).** Letter matches.
- P1: `DocSchema` (`spec/src/system/doc.zod.ts:31`), kernel `doc` (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts:1164`, `supportsOverlay: false`; `metadata-type-schemas.ts:164`), `os build` collection + publish lint (`cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`, "Package documentation collection + lint (ADR-0046)"). **True.**
- P2: console documentation portal (`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:296-314` — `/docs`, `DocPage`; `pages/AppDocsIndex.tsx`), help menu loading `doc` metadata (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx:488,625`), Studio doc editor (`DocPreview.tsx`, `ResourceEditPage.docEditor-10188.test.tsx`). **True.**
- P3a/P3b: `BookSchema` + `defineBook()` (`book.zod.ts:139,190`), orphan pass (`book.zod.ts:312-397`), `book` registered (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts:1181`), `GET /meta/book/:name/tree` (`rest/src/index.ts:121`, `meta-item-read-gate.ts:370-398`), §6.7 `docs-audience` arm — `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` to anonymous (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:237`). **True.**
- P3c pending: no drag/reorder in `DocPreview.tsx`; `apps/docs` does not read `/meta/doc` or `/meta/book`. **True.** (Studio's `BookPreview.tsx:171` already consumes the tree — the line names only the still-missing P3c parts, which is accurate.)
- P3d pending "§5 tags": `DocSchema.tags` exists and `collect-docs.ts:88-97` reads frontmatter `tags:` as the operand of a book group's `include: { tag }` rule — that is the §6 navigation axis, which §6.3 separates from §5 tags (faceted discovery/search). The pending claim holds for §5's discovery surface, but a reader who greps `tags` will find it live. **should-fix** (wording): `§5 tag-based discovery` or add `(DocSchema.tags exists as the book-include operand)`.

**docs/adr/0051-inline-metadata-views-in-docs.md — Accepted (ruling item 4: A).** Letter matches; the stale "no runtime rendering" sentence is gone as the ruling requires.
- Fence lift: `ui/packages/plugin-markdown/src/MarkdownImpl.tsx:120-166` (`parseMetadataFence`, `MetadataFence` → `ComponentRegistry.get("element:metadata_viewer")`, graceful raw-code fallback). **True.**
- Viewer: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/metadata-viewer.tsx` — `state_machine` (:177), `flow` with the §3.4 `detail: business` altitude projection (:362-430, `TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` folded), `permission` matrix (:439+). Spec entry `ElementMetadataViewerPropsSchema` → `'element:metadata_viewer'` in `ComponentPropsMap` (`component.zod.ts:2934,8472`, "embeddableInDoc"). **True.**
- Publish lint: `collect-docs.ts lintMetadataEmbeds` with liveness checks (`collect-docs.test.ts:11` "lintMetadataEmbeds (ADR-0051)"). **True.**
- P3 nuance (observation, no fix): the viewer draws the declared matrix and states that the graph is "read from the rule, not from who is looking"; the per-reader projection §3.5 places "at the resolver" is the item-level `/meta` read gate (`meta-item-read-gate.ts`: anonymous deny, ADR-0049 gated audiences deny), which the viewer degrades on (`failed` / `notFound` placeholders). That matches §3.3's placeholder posture; P3's "ships only once the §6.7 gate is in place" holds.
- Deferred list (`object`, `objectui` fence) unchanged (§5). **True.**

**docs/adr/0052-audit-is-not-the-activity-feed.md — Accepted, narrowed (ruling item 5: A narrowed).** Letter matches.
- §5b: `trackHistory` consumed in `audit-writers.ts:768,832` ("ADR-0052 §5b — declarative activity"), `activityMilestones` on `object.zod.ts:2868` ("ADR-0052 §5b.2"). **True.**
- P0b: `audit-plugin.ts` registers `[SysAuditLog, SysActivity, SysComment, SysCommentReaction]`; `SysAttachment` in `service-storage`, `SysNotification` in `service-messaging`. **True.**
- P1: `service-feed` has no files on `main`; `sys_comment.parent_id` (threads) live, `reactions` as the `sys_comment_reaction` object + reactions door (the `sys_comment.reactions` column retired under #22573 — the line says "with reactions and threads", which the object and the door satisfy); ChatterPanel `enableReactions: true, enableThreading: true` (`record-chatter.tsx:173-174`). HotCRM's `opportunityActivityHook` is gone (0 hits); `trackHistory: true` / `activityMilestones` declared across its objects. **True.**
- P2 pending: `audit-writers.ts:1271,1274` still `create`s `sys_audit_log` then `sys_activity`; `audit-writers.ts:229` names "event-spine (ADR-0052 §P2)" as future; HotCRM `activity-actions.ts:357` still hand-inserts `sys_activity` (the §6 P2 retirement). **True.**
- **should-fix (follow-up, outside this PR's status-line scope):** §6 P0b body still reads "`sys_notification` is **deferred** … ⚠️ whether the move now proceeds is a call for this record's owner" while the status line records the move as done and the tree confirms it. Flip that paragraph to ✅ in a body-edit PR so the record does not contradict its own status line.

**docs/adr/README.md** — judged in ① against `scripts/adr-index.mjs`: keyword, cell cut, date fallback, supersession extraction and counts all follow the generator; the report-only step on the head emitted no stale/unparsed warning; `main` has not moved under it. **No finding.**

Implemented-by: `claude/hopeful-heisenberg-x0vxac`
Reviewed-by: `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

This seat's account is in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` and does not dequeue, ready or merge governed PRs, so the PR lands as approved on `da5cf79ddc`.

The must-fix is held as a ready commit and lands right after this PR merges, as its own XS `docs/adr/**` follow-up PR (Tier H, the maintainer approves), with the ADR-0052 §6 P0b body paragraph flipped to ✅ in the same PR. The letters of ruling 6458958232 are unchanged by either edit. The review's `should-fix` and `must-fix` rows are therefore answered: fixed, pending the follow-up PR's landing; the contract review thread stays open until that PR is merged.
